mode: Four abstract plants (500,501,519,520), Louis XVI (212), and Runaway Zombie (213). Tucking Sunflower (520, native slot 53, legacy key AWKWARD_SUNFLOWER) replaces Awkward Sunflower in place. Still a 50-sun card unlocked from adventure 1-6 with a three-second card cooldown, producing native 25-value suns at unchanged speed. Same-lane nearby hostile zombies cause its native head and petals to lower together as the stalk retracts. Chewing/vault targets ignore tucked flowers and walkers continue toward the backline; collateral damage is not disabled. It recovers when the danger passes, with proximity hysteresis to avoid edge flicker. Gaze, embarrassment slowdown, generated face and sweat drop are removed from runtime; historical assets remain archived only. Legacy optional saves migrate without changing health, native production progress or campaign progress. Ordinary sunflower and other characters remain unchanged.
